# Orvio 0.44

- Newer video player (Media3 1.11.1) with the latest playback fixes; surround sound (AC3, E-AC3, DTS) still plays on devices that cannot decode it themselves.
- The password field is the same size as the other fields.
- With more than one playlist, Live TV opens on the channel list instead of the categories.
- The playlist buttons in Live TV are small and quiet: only the chosen playlist is lit.
